disclaimer.title: Important:
disclaimer.medical: This panel must not be used for treatment decisions. Data may be delayed or incomplete. Use the official app for alarms.

footer.unaffiliated: An unofficial, independent open-source project, not affiliated with Abbott.

auth.setupIntro: There are no users yet. Create the first administrator (ADMIN) account. This page closes after setup.

consent.title: Privacy notice and explicit consent
consent.p1: This panel processes glucose readings of monitored people (health data — special category personal data under KVKK/GDPR).
consent.p2: Data is shown only to authorised users of this panel, stored encrypted and deleted after the retention period. You can ask the administrator to export or delete the data.
consent.p3: The detailed privacy notice is provided by the administrator. By continuing you confirm you have read it and give explicit consent to processing for this purpose.
consent.accept: I have read the privacy notice and consent to health data being processed in this panel.

errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired or the credentials are wrong.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.CONFLICT: This conflicts with an existing record.
errors.LLU_BAD_CREDENTIALS: LibreLinkUp email or password is wrong.
errors.LLU_ACTION_REQUIRED: The LibreLinkUp account has a pending confirmation (terms of use etc.).
errors.LLU_VERSION_TOO_OLD: The LibreLinkUp client version is no longer accepted.
errors.LLU_NETWORK: Could not reach the LibreLinkUp server.

hint.default: Try again; if the problem persists contact your administrator.
hint.UNAUTHORIZED: Check your email and password and sign in again.
hint.CSRF: Reload the page and try again.
hint.RATE_LIMITED: Wait a minute and try again.
hint.LLU_BAD_CREDENTIALS: Verify the credentials in the LibreLinkUp mobile app.
hint.LLU_ACTION_REQUIRED: Open the LibreLinkUp mobile app and accept the pending terms.
hint.LLU_VERSION_TOO_OLD: The system retries automatically; otherwise raise LLU_VERSION.
hint.LLU_RATE_LIMITED: Wait a while; the system backs off automatically.
hint.LLU_NO_CONNECTIONS: Use a separate follower (LibreLinkUp) account instead of the patient's own and accept the invitation.

patient.none: You have no accessible patients. Ask your administrator for access or add a LibreLinkUp account.

trend.interval: Data frequency: about every {{value}} min (LibreLinkUp's update rate; the panel checks every minute).
trend.projectionBasis: Slope of {{count}} readings over the last {{minutes}} min: {{rate}} {{unit}}/min
trend.projectionUnavailable: Not enough recent data for a projection (needs at least 3 readings in the last 20 minutes and a value newer than 10 minutes).
trend.selectHint: Tap two readings on the chart to see the change and trend between them.
trend.extension: If this trend continues, in {{minutes}} min ≈ {{value}} {{unit}}
trend.disclaimer: Projection and trend are only a mathematical (linear) extension of past values; they ignore meals, insulin, exercise and sensor lag. Do not use for treatment decisions.

live.stale: Data delayed — the last reading is older than 15 minutes. Check the patient's phone and the LibreLink app.
live.polling: No live connection; refreshing every minute.

daily.gmiIndicative: Indicative only for a single day

reports.insufficient: Insufficient data in this period ({{value}}%); metrics may be misleading.

sections.periods: 6. Periods of day and days of week

agp.title: AGP chart
agp.legend: Thick line: median (50%). Dark band: 25–75%. Light band: 5–95%. Green band: target range.

gri.title: Glycemia Risk Index (GRI)
gri.zones: Dashed lines mark zones: A (0–20), B (20–40), C (40–60), D (60–80), E (80–100). Lower is better.

compare.note: Compared with the previous period of equal length. ▲ improved, ▼ worse.

meals.intro: Average response by meal notes ({{unit}}). Meal type is inferred from time of day.

alertKinds.lowDesc: When below threshold (default 70) for the given duration.
alertKinds.highDesc: When above threshold (default 250) for the given duration.
alertKinds.rapid_fallDesc: When trend is falling quickly and value below threshold (default 120).
alertKinds.staleDesc: When no new data for the given duration (default 20 min).
alertKinds.sensor_endingDesc: When less than 24 h remain, once a day.

push.title: Notifications

state.unsupported: This browser does not support Web Push.
state.denied: Notification permission denied. Allow it in browser settings.
state.unsubscribed: This device does not receive notifications.

push.iosNote: On iPhone/iPad notifications only work when the app is added to the home screen (iOS 16.4+): Safari Share → Add to Home Screen, then open it from the home screen.
push.delayNote: Notifications depend on the cloud and internet connection and may be delayed; they do not replace the official app's alarms.

settings.iosInstall: iPhone/iPad: Safari Share → Add to Home Screen.
settings.installUnavailable: Your browser doesn't offer an install prompt; use "Install app" from the browser menu.

llu.title: LibreLinkUp accounts
llu.followerNote: Use a separate LibreLinkUp follower account, not the patient's own LibreLink account (the patient invites from the app, the follower accepts in LibreLinkUp).
llu.label: Label
llu.confirmDelete: The account and all patient data will be deleted. Type the label to confirm: {{label}}

v920.fix: Raise the version to minimumVersion (also retried automatically)

header.fix: Check the client sends the sha256(user.id) header

s2.fix: Verify credentials in the LibreLinkUp mobile app

s4.fix: Open the LibreLinkUp mobile app and accept

empty.cause: Patient's own account used or invitation not accepted
empty.fix: Use a separate follower account and accept the invitation

r429.cause: Too frequent requests or too many failed logins
r429.fix: Wait for backoff; increase polling interval

delay.cause: Patient phone offline, LibreLink closed/battery optimisation, Bluetooth drop
delay.fix: Check the patient's phone; disable battery optimisation for LibreLink

gaps.fix: Up to 12 h is backfilled automatically; otherwise import CSV

import.title: LibreView CSV import — {{name}}
import.intro: Upload the glucose CSV downloaded from the LibreView website (max 20 MB). Existing readings are kept.

deleteData.title: Data deletion — {{name}}
deleteData.intro: All readings, notes, sensor and alert records of this patient will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone; export to CSV first.
deleteData.typeName: Type the patient name to confirm: "{{name}}" (within {{sec}} s)

entry.quickHint: Log what happens now with one tap, or pick a past time. Entries appear as markers on the chart.

errors.sleepRange: Wake-up must be after falling asleep and within 24 hours.
